title: The Umbrella Academy (TV series)
search_title_used: The Umbrella Academy We Only See Each Other at Weddings and Funerals
premise_summary: The Umbrella Academy is an American superhero comedy drama television series loosely based on the comic book series of the same name written by Gerard Way, illustrated by Gabriel Bá, and published by Dark Horse Comics. Created for Netflix by Steve Blackman and developed by Jeremy Slater, it revolves around a dysfunctional family of adopted sibling superheroes who reunite for their father's funeral and the threat of an imminent apocalypse. The series was produced by Borderline Entertainment, Irish Cowboy, Dark Horse Entertainment, and Universal Content Productions.
